exposure: Women of advanced maternal age (≥35 years)
Women who regularly accessed antenatal services
Women of relatively high socio-economic status
cohort: Women who gave birth in Bangladesh between 2004 and 2014
finding: The use of cesarean section has increased considerably in Bangladesh from 2004 to 2014, with a higher rate of increase observed among women of advanced maternal age, living in urban areas, and of relatively high socio-economic status.
